_note: Static snapshot refreshed daily by .github/workflows/sync-icon-sets.yml (bin/sync-icon-sets.php). Each set pins key/package/repository; title, description, license, icon_count, icon_counts (per kind: icon, illustration), variants, latest_version and visibility (the repository's GitHub visibility, public or private) are synced from the pack’s config.json at its latest GitHub tag. To add a set, append an entry carrying at least key, package, repository, title, icon_count and variants — IconSetCatalogService rejects any set missing one of those six, treating an empty string or empty array as missing, so a set pinned with only the first three makes ichava::ichava-core.install throw until the next nightly sync fills the rest. Take the values from the pack’s own config.json and let the workflow refresh them. Write with JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE, as this file is generated and any other encoding reflows it. ichava::ichava-core.install reads this file only — zero runtime network calls.

sets.title: Flag Icons

sets.title: Twemoji
sets.description: Twemoji, Twitter/X's open-source emoji set, as SVG. Unicode 17 / Emoji 17 spec. Categorised by Unicode CLDR groups. OpenMoji is in ichava/icon-sets-openmoji.
